title: Validity-Headroom Ceiling for Tailwise Pharmacy Pharmacy-Placed Renewals
content:
The days' supply per fill of a renewal Tailwise Pharmacy places by itself is no more than the validity-headroom ceiling. The validity-headroom ceiling counts the calendar days from the renewed prescription's closing date to its expiry date, as the prescription record shows them.

## Ceiling

- Where the renewed prescription stands at refills exhausted with at least 60 such days, the ceiling is the class's maximum days' supply per fill.
- Where it stands at refills exhausted with fewer than 60 such days, the ceiling is the renewed prescription's days' supply per fill plus 15 days, never more than the class maximum.
- Otherwise, for a renewed prescription that stands at expired, the ceiling is the renewed prescription's days' supply per fill.

## Boundary (hypothetical dates; prescription written for 60 days, class maximum 90 days)

| Status | Closing date | Expiry date | Days between | Ceiling |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| refills exhausted | 2026-03-02 | 2026-05-01 | 60 | 90 days |
| refills exhausted | 2026-03-03 | 2026-05-01 | 59 | 60 plus 15: 75 days |
| expired | 2026-05-01 | 2026-05-01 | | 60 days |
